title: Ten amber-only UI options
scope: Generated concepts with synthetic content. Target colors are approximate. No native UI or accessibility certification.

options.name: Soft Amber
options.description: Warm charcoal and a soft amber action.
options.note: Restrained warm charcoal, warm ivory content, softened gold on the small primary action and keyboard focus. This is the closest gentle alternative to Amber Black.
options.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity desktop application UI concept, edge to edge in a landscape 1536 by 1024 composition. This is an amber-only palette comparison for practical automation tools, with synthetic sample data. Flat crisp UI, highly legible system sans, regular-weight body, concise labels, compact spacing with enough breathing room. No device, desk, browser chrome, poster, photography, grain, gradients, glow, glass, ornamental artwork, or giant headline.
Keep this same arrangement and content in every option: a slim top toolbar with title "Task review" and search; narrow left navigation "Workspace", "Tasks", "Activity", "Settings"; center "Daily report" task list with columns "Task" and "State", four rows "Load file", "Check filename", "Save report", "Archive file", and states "Ready", "Needs input", "Ready", "Waiting"; "Check filename" is selected with a quiet tonal row fill and a small amber outline. Right panel "Task properties" has "Output filename" with "report.csv", "Workspace" with read-only "Local sample", a disabled "Schedule" field, and a small primary "Apply changes" plus neutral secondary "Cancel". Include one compact amber warning with a warning icon and text "Name required". Bottom code line: output_file = "report.csv". Footer "Synthetic preview".
Only amber/gold hues and their warm neutral tints and shades, black, gray, cream, and ivory. Absolutely no blue, green, red, purple, teal, or pink, including icons, code, and status colors. Convey status through text and outline icon shape. Accent fills occupy less than 8% of the screen. Most surfaces remain quiet neutrals. Keep readable text, clear field edges and a visible small focus outline. Plain monochrome line icons. Target colors below guide the concept; do not print hex codes or swatches.
Option 01: Soft Amber. Restrained warm charcoal, warm ivory content, softened gold on the small primary action and keyboard focus. This is the closest gentle alternative to Amber Black.
